ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.50:0.50 ratio of high-intensity white to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two distinct lateral white fields flanking a central black peduncle region. Left lobe: contains an ochre-toned patch on the upper margin and dark mottling near the central divide. Right lobe: contains multiple dark focal spots in the lateral mid-field and a distinct yellowish-brown patch near the central black boundary.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with an estimated internal angle of 135 degrees and a defined vertex point.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serrations; right lobe shows high-amplitude peaks towards the distal tip; left lobe shows more uniform, lower-amplitude serrations along the trailing margin.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex sweep trajectory along the superior boundaries of both lobes, culminating in acute, slightly rounded distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of multiple small, dark circular pixel clusters localized on the white field of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent dark vertical linear mark on the far right distal tip; one dark diagonal linear mark on the far left distal tip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Vertical linear trauma mark on the right distal tip; distinctive yellowish-brown circular patch on the inner region of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique asymmetrical pigmentation pattern involving a combination of ochre-toned patches and scattered dark focal spots across the ventral white substrate.
